milestone.title: Lean spec model — drop 18 unused ceremony fields (2.0 clean break, no back-compat)

intent.outcome: A milestone spec contains only fields that earn their place: intent.outcome, problem.description, scope (in/out), acceptance_criteria, design_decisions, open_questions, milestone metadata, and work_packages/steps/verification. The ~18 proven-unused section fields are removed from schema, templates, validate, create, show, raul, docs, and skills. On-disk artifact re-baseline (strip empty scaffolding) ships in M92 migration — single pass with TOML→JSON, not a separate M82 file sweep.

problem.description: A complete 2026-07-01 field census across all 80 milestones proved 18 spec fields are 100% unused (never filled in a single milestone): the entire section objects [behavior] (scenarios, edge_cases), [interface] (endpoints, config_keys, cli_commands, entities), [requirements] (functional, needs_clarification), [context] (related, references), [technical_context] (key_files, dependencies, constraints), and [delta] (changes); plus the top-level arrays success_criteria, assumptions, risks, follow_ups. This is dead ceremony: every milestone TOML carries ~18 empty scaffolding lines, the create template emits them, and the schema/validate/skills/docs all teach and carry them. This is exactly the SDD over-ceremony that Böckeler (martinfowler.com, Oct 2025) warns amplifies review overload. Confirmed load-bearing (KEEP): intent.outcome (0% empty), problem.description (0%), scope.in_scope (92%)/out_of_scope (100%), acceptance_criteria, design_decisions (16% real use), open_questions (11% real use). Note (to resolve at grooming): dropping context.references and delta removes the unused brownfield scaffolding — brownfield needs are currently served (weakly) by scope + problem.description, and should be re-confirmed rather than kept as dead fields. technical_context was nominally the Phase-2 technical home; its content moves into design_decisions / work_packages / steps.

in_scope: Remove the 18 proven-unused fields from milestone.schema.json, the create --example template, mp validate, mp milestone create (no scaffolding emission), mp show, raul, docs, and the master-planner/spec-grill skills
KEEP the load-bearing fields: intent.outcome, problem.description, scope, acceptance_criteria, design_decisions, open_questions, metadata, work_packages, steps, verification
Re-confirm how (if at all) brownfield references are expressed going forward, rather than reviving the dead context/delta scaffolding
Coordinate with M92: schema/template/validate changes land in the same release wave as JSON migration
out_of_scope: Backwards-compatibility / migration shims for pre-2.0 plans (explicit 2.0 clean break)
Separate on-disk file re-baseline pass (owned by M92 — applies M82 field drops during TOML→JSON migration, single tree touch)
Adding new spec fields or new artifact types
The raul TUI rework and the spec-review surface (M80) — separate milestones
